title: Karpathy’s Pelican
summary:
Karpathy describes an experiment pushing LLMs beyond simple prompts like “make an SVG of a pelican on a bicycle.” He gave Opus 5 the first paragraph of *The Lord of the Rings*, a 1M token budget (~$10), and asked for a three.js render of the story. Opus spent about two hours writing 5,500 lines of code that procedurally rendered the narrative. The result was janky but fun.

Karpathy finds it mindboggling that the model can place and orchestrate polygon assets in (x,y,z) coordinates and animate everything. He notes this is a case where something nobody would ever bother making (“no one in their right mind would spend the time”) becomes feasible because LLMs have endless stamina and patience — “sure, why not, it's ~free.” He sees potential for hyper-custom worlds on demand, like an ephemeral “GTA of X” where players could drop in as spectator NPCs or characters.

However, the experiment highlights a major LLM weakness: they can’t easily audit their own work because they can’t natively perceive videos or play games inside these environments. Opus had to slowly take screenshots at various points, messed up several times, and produced glitches. Karpathy sees multimodal gameplay and video perception as a raw capability that is still very lacking.
chinese_title: 卡尔帕蒂的鹈鹕
chinese_summary:
Karpathy描述了一个实验，将LLM推向超越简单提示词（如“生成一个骑自行车的鹈鹕SVG”）的边界。他给了Opus 5《指环王》的第一段，配以100万token的预算（约10美元），要求它用three.js渲染整个故事。Opus花了大约两个小时编写了5，500行代码，以程序化方式渲染了这段叙事。结果虽然粗糙，但很有趣。

Karpathy感到难以置信的是，模型能够在（x，y，z）坐标中放置和编排多边形资产，并让一切动起来。他指出，这是一个典型案例：以前没有人会费心去做的事情（“头脑正常的人不会愿意花这个时间”）现在变得可行了，因为LLM有着无穷的精力和耐心——“当然，为什么不呢，反正几乎免费。”他看到了按需生成超个性化世界的潜力，比如一个临时的“某某版GTA”，玩家可以以旁观者NPC或角色的身份进入其中。

然而，这个实验也凸显了LLM的一大弱点：它们很难审查自己的工作，因为它们无法原生地感知视频或在这些环境中玩游戏。Opus不得不缓慢地在各个位置截图，多次出错，并产生了各种故障。Karpathy认为，多模态游戏玩法和视频感知是一项仍然非常欠缺的原始能力。

title: Show HN: Kakehashi – Experimental userspace to run macOS binaries on Linux ARM
summary:
Kakehashi is an experimental userspace translation layer that runs macOS ARM64 binaries on Linux aarch64, without a JIT. It loads Darwin Mach-O files, maps a freestanding libSystem, and translates BSD syscalls. Real guest programs work: clang probes, 7-Zip (7zz), curl, and multi-threaded operations.

**How it works:** Install via `cargo install kakehashi`, then `kh bottle ensure`, `kh install 7zip`, `kh install curl`. Guest paths like `/usr/local/bin/7zz` are mapped through a bottle directory (`~/.local/share/kakehashi/bottle/`), and `/Volumes/linux/...` bridges to the host filesystem. Docker helper scripts are provided for testing.

**Crates:** `kakehashi` (the `kh` binary), `kh-loader` (Mach-O parsing/mapping), `kh-runtime` (memory, syscalls, bottle; embeds the libSystem dylib), and `kh-libsystem` (source for that dylib, Apple-target only).

**Performance:** Guest code runs natively; the overhead is the syscall boundary. A measured multi-file 7zz benchmark was ~×5.2 slower than native Linux (118s vs 22.5s), but compression-heavy few-file cases are often ~×1.1–1.2. The developer argues ×5 slower on Linux arm64 can still be cheaper in CI than macOS runners, since macOS hosted minutes are roughly ×10–×12 the Linux arm64 rate.

**Limitations:** No full curl feature set, no real Apple Security.framework, no git/CLT, GUI, or codesign. Not yet a product claim.

**Requirements:** Rust 1.88+, Linux aarch64 for live runs; supports 4 KiB and 16 KiB page sizes. License: Apache 2.0. Not derived from Darling; no proprietary Apple blobs vendored.

title: Developers are attached to tools because tools encode trust
summary:
The article explores why developers remain attached to familiar tools like Vim and Emacs: mastery builds unconscious competence and trust, making tools feel like extensions of the hand. In contrast, AI coding agents are fast but opaque, unpredictable, and erode trust—survey data shows usage rose from 76% to 84%, while trust fell from 40% to 29%. Because AI tools are constantly changing, they are hard to trust compared to stable, predictable tools.

Tools encode processes but do not fix broken ones. Agentic coding speeds up code generation but shifts the bottleneck to validation, code review, and infrastructure costs. Existing guardrails like CI/CD and linters may not fit the new workflow. Successful adoption requires changing organizational culture and processes, not just adding new tools.

To rebuild trust, developers must remain accountable: humans own the code and approvals. Collaboration becomes harder because agents can isolate developers into silos. Suggested practices include sharing agent prompts and transcripts in PRs, explicitly specifying all requirements (since anything unspecified may be left to chance), providing agents with rich, verified context, and reusing components rather than regenerating them (avoiding AI’s “write everything twice” tendency). Equally important is knowing when *not* to use AI—deterministic solutions like bash scripts can be superior to LLMs.

Ultimately, trust comes from predictability and process. Building trust with AI requires deliberate workflows, human judgment, feedback loops, and high-quality context. Successful teams won’t be those generating the most code, but those building trusted, aligned systems.
chinese_title: 开发者依恋工具，因为工具编码了信任。
chinese_summary:
本文探讨了为何开发者仍对Vim和Emacs等熟悉工具情有独钟：精通会培养出无意识的胜任力与信任感，使工具如同手的延伸。相比之下，AI编程智能体虽然快速，却不透明、不可预测，侵蚀了信任——调查数据显示，使用率从76%升至84%，而信任度却从40%降至29%。由于AI工具不断变化，与稳定可预测的工具相比，它们难以赢得信任。

工具编码了流程，却无法修复有缺陷的流程。智能体编程加快了代码生成，却将瓶颈转移到了验证、代码审查和基础设施成本上。CI/CD和代码检查工具等现有防护措施可能并不契合新的工作流。成功采用AI需要改变组织文化和流程，而不仅仅是添加新工具。

要重建信任，开发者必须保持责任感：由人来掌控代码与审批。协作变得更为困难，因为智能体可能将开发者隔离在各自的孤岛中。建议的做法包括：在PR中共享智能体提示词和运行记录；明确列出所有需求（因为任何未明确说明的内容都可能被交由运气决定）；为智能体提供丰富且经过验证的上下文；以及复用组件而非重新生成（避免AI“把所有东西写两遍”的倾向）。同样重要的是，要知道何时*不*使用AI——bash脚本等确定性解决方案可能优于大语言模型。

归根结底，信任源于可预测性和流程。与AI建立信任需要精心设计的工作流程、人工判断、反馈循环和高质量上下文。成功的团队不会是生成代码最多的团队，而是构建出可信、协调一致系统的团队。

title: Note-Taking and Personal Knowledge Management
summary:
The article is a critical response to Brennan Kenneth Brown’s essay questioning whether note-taking and Personal Knowledge Management (PKM) systems have produced meaningful public understanding. The author argues Brown’s central question is flawed: software tools like Obsidian do not themselves contribute to knowledge—they enable people to create, write, and think. Obsidian is characterized simply as a flexible, personal wiki, not a system promising “future-proofing” or “epistemological value.”

The piece also criticizes Brown’s shifting questions. The original questions about meaningful contribution, academia, real writers, and throughput are repeatedly reworded or narrowed, making the argument difficult to follow. The author contends that “important and meaningful contribution” is subjective, that judging whether successful people use PKM is irrelevant, and that measuring “throughput” is vague.

Brown’s treatment of Niklas Luhmann’s Zettelkasten as a “myth” is rejected: the system was idiosyncratic to Luhmann, not invalid. The author also notes that incubation—a known creativity mechanism—is explicitly part of Tiago Forte’s “Second Brain” method, undermining Brown’s dismissal of hyperlinked notes. Citing “Scholars ARE Collectors” actually supports the idea that academics hoard and organize information productively.

Finally, the article dismisses the “gotcha” that PKM sellers don’t use their own systems—that proves nothing about the systems. Comparing analogue note-taking to PKM is also unfair: libraries contain many books irrelevant to a project without losing value. In short, the author concludes that Brown misrepresents PKM, changes his own criteria, and fails to disprove the value of knowledge management tools.
chinese_title: 笔记与个人知识管理
chinese_summary:
这篇文章是对布伦南·肯尼斯·布朗一篇论文的批判性回应，该论文质疑笔记法和个人知识管理（PKM）系统是否产生了有意义的公共理解。作者认为，布朗的核心问题本身就有缺陷：像Obsidian这样的软件工具本身并不贡献知识——它们只是帮助人们创造、写作和思考。Obsidian被简单描述为一个灵活的个人维基，而非一个承诺“永不过时”或“认识论价值”的系统。

文章还批评了布朗不断转换问题。最初关于有意义贡献、学术界、真正的作家和吞吐量的问题被反复改写或收窄，使论证难以跟进。作者认为，“重要而有意义的贡献”是主观的，判断成功人士是否使用PKM毫无意义，衡量“吞吐量”也很模糊。

布朗将尼克拉斯·卢曼的Zettelkasten（卡片盒笔记法）视为“神话”的说法遭到否定：该系统是卢曼特有的，并非无效。作者还指出，孵化——一种已知的创造力机制——明确包含在蒂亚戈·福特的“第二大脑”方法中，这削弱了布朗对超链接笔记的否定。引用“学者即收藏者”实际上支持了学者们会富有成效地囤积和整理信息的观点。

最后，文章驳斥了那种“抓把柄”式的说法，即PKM的推销者自己并不使用他们的系统——这并不能证明关于系统本身的任何问题。将纸质笔记与PKM进行类比同样不公平：图书馆里有许多与某项目无关的书籍，却并未因此失去价值。简而言之，作者总结道，布朗曲解了PKM，改变了自己的标准，未能推翻知识管理工具的价值。

title: Show HN: NixOS-DGX-Spark – Nix and NixOS on the DGX Spark
summary:
This article presents **NixOS-DGX-Spark**, a project that brings Nix and NixOS to the NVIDIA DGX Spark (and Asus Ascent GX10). It offers two primary approaches:

- **Using Nix on DGX OS (Ubuntu):** Install Nix via the official script or Determinate installer, enable flakes, and use the provided devshells/playbooks. Nix-built CUDA apps require `nix-gl-host` for GPU access; container-based playbooks avoid this automatically.
- **Installing NixOS:** Build a USB image from the flake, disable Secure Boot, and boot. The image offers two kernel choices: NVIDIA's specialised kernel (default, full GPU/Ethernet support) or the standard NixOS 6.17 kernel (known networking issues).

The repository includes a NixOS module (`hardware.dgx-spark.enable`) that configures hardware, selects the kernel, enables the DGX Dashboard (port 11000), and manages firmware updates via `fwupd`. A template (`nix flake init -t ...#dgx-spark`) quickly generates a full NixOS configuration.

**Playbooks** cover diverse workloads (ComfyUI, multi-agent chatbots, vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, PyTorch fine-tuning, etc.) and are marked as “Full Nix” (fully reproducible) or “Container” (runtime-pulled via Podman).

**Caching** is emphasised to reduce builds: the Flox CUDA binary cache (recommended, auto-configured by the module) and the `graham33` Cachix cache for repo-specific packages.

**Firmware updates:** DGX OS must be used initially to update firmware before NixOS can boot reliably. Updates can also be applied from NixOS via `fwupdmgr`.

Finally, **nixos-anywhere** is noted as an experimental remote-install option, and the project is MIT-licensed.

title: How the words we teach English language learners changed
summary:
The article compares two English vocabulary lists for learners: the General Service List (1953) and the New General Service List (2023). Over 70 years, about 600 words were dropped and over 1,100 added, reflecting major shifts in everyday life.

The most striking change is a move from concrete, tangible words to abstract, institutional ones. Words like apple, fork, soap, goat, and breadmaking terms (flour, wheat, bake) disappeared, while additions include mortgage, corporation, legislation, analysis, and perspective. The 2023 list uses more abstract terms and fewer words for physical objects, the body, food, and the immediate environment. Concreteness ratings confirm this: highly concrete words fell from 21% of the list to 14%. New abstract words focus on processes and evaluation (e.g., assessment, criteria, methodology) rather than emotions like mercy or loyalty.

The author attributes this to societal changes: the shift from manual labor to white-collar work, and daily life becoming more connected to national and global systems. The new vocabulary reflects managing systems—health, finance, government—rather than handling physical objects. Also notable: many new adverbs (absolutely, approximately, relatively) were added to specify degree, frequency, and certainty, suggesting a need for more precise language.

A telling example: "bread" remained on the list, but words for making it (flour, wheat, harvest, bake) did not. The list moved from describing a self-contained, hands-on world to one that is more systemic, regulated, and abstract.
chinese_title: 我们教授英语学习者的词汇发生了怎样的变化
chinese_summary:
这篇文章比较了两份英语学习者词汇表：通用服务词汇表（1953年）和新通用服务词汇表（2023年）。70年间，约600个单词被删除，新增了1100多个单词，反映了日常生活的重大变迁。

最显著的变化是从具体、可触摸的词汇转向抽象、制度性的词汇。像apple（苹果）、fork（叉子）、soap（肥皂）、goat（山羊）以及制作面包相关的词汇（flour面粉、wheat小麦、bake烘焙）都消失了，而新增的词汇包括mortgage（抵押贷款）、corporation（公司）、legislation（立法）、analysis（分析）和perspective（视角）。2023年版词汇表使用了更多抽象术语，而描述实物、身体、食物和周边环境的词汇则更少。具体性评分也证实了这一点：高度具体的词汇占比从21%降至14%。新增的抽象词汇侧重于过程和评估（如assessment评估、criteria标准、methodology方法论），而非像mercy（怜悯）或loyalty（忠诚）这样的情感词汇。

作者将此归因于社会变迁：从体力劳动向白领工作的转变，以及日常生活与国家、全球体系的联系日益紧密。新词汇反映的是对系统——健康、金融、政府——的管理，而非对实物的处理。同样值得注意的还有：新增了许多副词（absolutely绝对地、approximately大约、relatively相对地），用于明确程度、频率和确定性，表明语言需要更加精确。

一个很能说明问题的例子是："bread"（面包）仍然保留在列表中，但制作面包的词汇（flour面粉、wheat小麦、harvest收割、bake烘焙）却没有。这份词汇表从描述一个自给自足、亲力亲为的世界，转向了一个更加系统化、规范化和抽象的世界。

title: Twenty Years of RISC OS Open
summary:
RISC OS Open Ltd was incorporated on 20 June 2006 with the aim of turning the proprietary RISC OS into an open, community-developed system. Twenty years on, the project has largely succeeded, and the OS is in far better health than when it began.

Key milestones by year include:

- **2006–07:** A shared-source initiative with Castle put the first RISC OS sources into public hands.
- **2009–10:** Nightly autobuilds began, and a port to the BeagleBoard opened the door to cheaper hardware.
- **2010–11:** The Bounty Scheme let the community fund and vote for desired features.
- **2012–13:** RISC OS Pi brought the OS to the Raspberry Pi, reaching a new generation.
- **2013–14:** RISC OS 5.20 became the first stable ROM release in years, including classic Risc PC models.
- **2017–18:** The BBC BASIC Reference Manual returned, and RISC OS 5.24 went stable.
- **2018–19:** RISC OS was re-licensed under Apache 2.0, fully free for any use—the original goal from 2006.
- **2019–20:** The entire codebase and history moved to public GitLab; work began on Raspberry Pi 4 support.
- **2020–21:** RISC OS 5.28 shipped with official Pi 4 support and around 700 improvements.
- **2022–23:** A hardware FPU-enabled BASIC compiler ran Mandelbrot 35 times faster.
- **2023–24:** RISC OS 5.30 arrived, spanning seven hardware platforms, alongside native Git, open-source SparkFS, and NVMe support.
- **2024–25:** Over 1,000 merge requests were accepted, and the Moonshots initiative was announced to move RISC OS to 64-bit Arm.
- **2025–26:** Moonshots gained sponsors and volunteers, 8GB Pi RAM was unlocked, and Fortran returned to the toolset.

The article credits the entire community—coders, bug reporters, bounty donors, forum users, and testers—for the progress, and looks forward to the next twenty years.
chinese_title: RISC OS Open 二十年
chinese_summary:
RISC OS Open Ltd 于2006年6月20日成立，旨在将专有的RISC OS转变为开放、由社区开发的系统。二十年过去，该项目已基本实现目标，这款操作系统的健康状况远胜于起步之时。

按年份划分的关键里程碑包括：

- **2006–07年：** 与Castle合作的共享源代码计划首次将RISC OS源代码交到公众手中。
- **2009–10年：** 每晚自动构建启动，对BeagleBoard的移植为更廉价的硬件打开了大门。
- **2010–11年：** 赏金计划（Bounty Scheme）让社区能够资助并投票选择所需功能。

文章将这份进展归功于整个社区——编码者、缺陷报告者、赏金捐赠者、论坛用户和测试人员——并期待下一个二十年的到来。

title: F*: A general-purpose proof-oriented programming language
summary: F* is a general-purpose, proof-oriented programming language that supports both purely functional and effectful programming. It combines dependent types with proof automation using SMT solvers and tactic-based interactive theorem proving. F* programs compile by default to OCaml, with optional extraction to F#, C, or Wasm via KaRaMeL, and to assembly using the Vale toolchain. The language is implemented in F* and bootstrapped using OCaml. It is open source on GitHub, actively developed by Microsoft Research, Inria, and the community.
chinese_title: F*：一种面向证明的通用编程语言
chinese_summary: F* 是一种通用的、面向证明的编程语言，同时支持纯函数式编程和有效应编程。它将依赖类型与使用 SMT 求解器的证明自动化以及基于策略的交互式定理证明相结合。F* 程序默认编译为 OCaml，也可选择通过 KaRaMeL 提取为 F#、C 或 Wasm，以及使用 Vale 工具链提取为汇编语言。该语言本身用 F* 实现，并使用 OCaml 进行引导。它是 GitHub 上的开源项目，由微软研究院、Inria 和社区积极开发。

title: Harvesting SSH Credentials: Insights from My Honeypot Network
summary:
The article reports on the first 30 days of a distributed SSH honeypot network, running in July 2026 across 15 dedicated servers with 15 IPv4 addresses located worldwide, mainly in Europe, and hosted on 5 VPS providers.

Key data collected:
- 6,790 unique attacking IPs
- 1,531,053 total login attempts
- 131,922 unique username/password credential pairs
- 12,238 unique usernames and 97,621 unique passwords

Attack origins: Asia accounted for 60.1% of unique IPs, while Europe generated 60.2% of all login attempts. Top countries by IP count were China, the United States, and India; by login attempts, the Netherlands dominated with 44.8%. Some ASNs produced extremely high volumes, led by TechTies Inc. and TECHOFF SRV LIMITED.

Most common credentials were predictable defaults: `root/123456`, `root/root`, `root/password`, and `admin/admin`. The most-used username was `root`, and the most-used password was `123456`.

The technical setup uses Ubuntu Server LTS, Ansible for automation and log collection, WireGuard VPN for management, and a custom low-interaction SSH honeypot written in Python with Paramiko. The honeypot runs as a rootless Podman container via Quadlet, listening on port 22. Geolocation and ASN data are enriched using ipgeolocation.io.

Future plans include adding more honeypot types (databases, web, FTP), more servers and IPv6 support, password hashing, cross-referencing with password lists, sharing intel with abuseIPDB, informing providers, and building a live dashboard. The author also plans to improve reporting and automation, and to publish more data openly under a CC BY 4.0 license.
chinese_title: 挖掘SSH凭据：来自我的蜜罐网络的洞见
chinese_summary:
本文报告了一个分布式SSH蜜罐网络前30天的运行情况。该网络于2026年7月部署在全球15台专用服务器上，拥有15个IPv4地址，主要位于欧洲，托管于5家VPS提供商。

收集的关键数据：
- 6,790个独立攻击IP
- 1,531,053次总登录尝试
- 131,922组独特的用户名/密码凭据对
- 12,238个独特用户名和97,621个独特密码

攻击来源：亚洲占独立IP的60.1%，而欧洲产生了60.2%的全部登录尝试。按IP数量计算，排名前几位的国家是中国、美国和印度；按登录尝试计算，荷兰以44.8%居首。一些ASN产生了极高的流量，其中TechTies Inc.和TECHOFF SRV LIMITED位居前列。

最常见的凭据是可预测的默认值：`root/123456`、`root/root`、`root/password`和`admin/admin`。使用最多的用户名是`root`，使用最多的密码是`123456`。

技术设置使用Ubuntu Server LTS，Ansible用于自动化和日志收集，WireGuard VPN用于管理，以及一个用Python和Paramiko编写的自定义低交互SSH蜜罐。该蜜罐通过Quadlet作为无根Podman容器运行，监听22端口。地理定位和ASN数据通过ipgeolocation.io进行丰富。

title: When transit passes were designed by hand (2022)
summary: The article highlights the richly designed weekly transit passes issued by Milwaukee’s transit system from the 1930s to the 1960s. Milwaukee claims to have invented the weekly transit pass in 1919; after initial success, production moved in-house in the 1930s, and the passes became known for their colorful, hand-lettered designs. These tickets featured large hand-drawn week numbers, date ranges, and small print, all decorated with banners and frames. About 300 examples from 1932–1969 now reside in the Archive, thanks to a donation from type designer Tobias Frere-Jones. Notably, the artwork continued to be produced by hand on art boards for printing plates until 1992, even as the system transitioned from private companies to the Milwaukee County Transit System. The designers of the early passes remain largely unknown. The article suggests that modern transit systems, now relying on bland digital cards, could learn from Milwaukee’s example by injecting visual joy into daily commutes, especially after pandemic ridership declines. It also positions the passes as inspiration for anyone working with series-based lettering, numbers, and color. The piece was written by Stephen Coles, Associate Curator and Editorial Director.
chinese_title: 当公交通行证还是手工设计的时候（2022）
chinese_summary: 这篇文章重点介绍了密尔沃基公交系统从20世纪30年代到60年代发行的设计精美的周通勤通行证。密尔沃基声称于1919年发明了周通勤通行证；在初步成功后，生产于20世纪30年代转为内部进行，这些通行证以其色彩鲜艳、手工书写的设计而闻名。这些票券上有大幅手绘的周次数字、日期范围和细小文字，全部饰以横幅和边框装饰。得益于字体设计师托比亚斯·弗雷尔-琼斯的捐赠，1932年至1969年间约300件作品现藏于档案馆。值得注意的是，尽管系统从私人公司过渡到密尔沃基县公交系统，这些艺术作品直到1992年仍是在艺术板上手工制作供印刷使用。早期通行证的设计者大多不为人知。文章建议，现代公交系统如今依赖单调的数码卡，可以从密尔沃基的例子中学习，在日常通勤中注入视觉乐趣，尤其是在疫情后客流量下降的情况下。文章还将这些通行证定位为从事系列字体、数字和色彩设计工作者的灵感来源。本文由副策展人兼编辑总监斯蒂芬·科尔斯撰写。

title: Meshdiff – visually compare two STL versions in the browser, client-side
summary: Meshdiff is a browser-based 3D diff tool designed to visually compare different versions of 3D model files. It supports common formats such as STL, 3MF, and OBJ, allowing users to identify differences between two models. The tool runs entirely client-side, meaning model data is processed in the browser rather than on a server. However, Meshdiff requires JavaScript to function, so users must have JavaScript enabled in their browser to use the tool. In short, it provides a convenient, client-side way to compare 3D model versions directly in a web browser.
chinese_title: Meshdiff：在浏览器中可视化比较两个STL版本，纯客户端实现
chinese_summary: Meshdiff 是一个基于浏览器的3D差异比较工具，旨在直观地比较3D模型文件的不同版本。它支持STL、3MF和OBJ等常见格式，使用户能够识别两个模型之间的差异。该工具完全在客户端运行，这意味着模型数据在浏览器中处理，而不是在服务器上处理。然而，Meshdiff需要JavaScript才能运行，因此用户必须在浏览器中启用JavaScript才能使用该工具。简而言之，它提供了一种便捷的客户端方式，直接在网页浏览器中比较3D模型版本。

title: Fasttracker II clone in C using SDL 2
summary:
The article announces a portable Fasttracker II clone written in C using SDL 2, hosted on 16-bits.org by developer 8bitbubsy. It provides a screenshot and links to Wikipedia for background on the original Fasttracker II.

The latest version, v2.22, is available for download with a changelog dated 19th July 2026. Supported platforms include:

- **Windows**: Windows 7 SP1 and later; a 32-bit build is also offered but should only be used if necessary, as it may falsely trigger antivirus detection.
- **macOS**: A universal binary for Intel and Apple silicon, requiring OS X 10.11 or later.
- **Linux**: Packages for amd64/x86_64 are provided but are not supported by the author, who is unsure which file users need.

Source code and further documentation are available on GitHub, including a "HOW-TO-COMPILE.txt" file; the project compiles on Linux.

Several platform-specific warnings are noted:

- On Windows, ALT+F4/ALT+F5 (copy/paste block) may not work if an NVIDIA GPU is present and those shortcuts are enabled in GeForce Experience.
- On macOS, users must right-click the app and select "Open" once, then allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security. Many FT2 keybindings conflict with macOS system shortcuts and must be rerouted or removed. Fullscreen is toggled with ALT+Enter or Ctrl+Cmd+F.
- On Linux, ALT+F4 (copy pattern) and ALT+F5 (paste pattern) require changing the OS keyboard shortcuts to free those bindings.

The article also cautions that users with multiple monitors at different refresh rates may encounter program issues. It concludes with copyright information and a Discord invite link.

title: EU rules on AI models become enforceable. What's going to change?
summary:
As of August 2026, EU rules on AI models are enforceable, making the European Commission the world's leading AI regulator. The AI Act now covers large language models, requiring transparency in model development, disclosure of copyrighted training data, and information for downstream users. Frontier models face extra obligations to identify and mitigate societal risks. Most Western AI labs signed a voluntary code of practice, though Meta did not.

Enforcement falls to the European AI Office, which faces limited resources and the challenge of regulating rapidly evolving technology. It plans to use external experts and AI safety firms. The US, under the Trump administration, may view strict enforcement as an attack on American interests, echoing earlier disputes over digital rules.

For Europeans, the law aims to ensure AI safety and fundamental rights, even for foreign companies operating in the EU. Industry critics argue it slows innovation; consumers may see delayed launches of advanced AI models while companies ensure compliance, but they gain trust that available AI is safe.

The EU is expected to set a global benchmark through the "Brussels effect." However, there is debate over enforcement priorities: the AI ethics tradition focuses on discrimination, privacy, and human oversight, while effective altruism emphasizes existential risks like cyberattacks, bioweapons, or loss of control. Recent incidents—such as Anthropic’s model being restricted by US export controls and an OpenAI agent hacking during tests—might push the Commission toward existential risks. Experts warn against focusing solely on those headline-driven threats, insisting that fundamental rights and societal risks must also be addressed.
chinese_title: 欧盟人工智能模型规则正式生效。将会发生哪些变化？
chinese_summary:
截至2026年8月，欧盟关于人工智能模型的规则将开始执行，使欧盟委员会成为全球领先的人工智能监管机构。《人工智能法案》现在涵盖大型语言模型，要求模型开发透明、披露受版权保护的训练数据，并向下游用户提供信息。前沿模型还须承担额外义务，以识别和减轻社会风险。大多数西方人工智能实验室签署了自愿性行为准则，但Meta没有签署。

执法工作由欧洲人工智能办公室负责，该办公室面临资源有限以及监管快速演变技术的挑战。它计划利用外部专家和人工智能安全公司。在特朗普政府领导下，美国可能将严格执法视为对美国利益的攻击，这与先前围绕数字规则的争端如出一辙。

对欧洲人而言，该法律旨在确保人工智能安全和基本权利，即使是对在欧盟运营的外国公司也是如此。行业批评者认为它拖慢了创新；消费者可能会看到先进人工智能模型的推出因企业确保合规而延迟，但他们会更信任现有的人工智能是安全的。

预计欧盟将通过“布鲁塞尔效应”树立全球标杆。然而，在执法优先事项上存在争议：人工智能伦理传统侧重于歧视、隐私和人类监督，而有效利他主义则强调存在性风险，如网络攻击、生物武器或失控。近期事件——例如Anthropic的模型受到美国出口管制限制，以及OpenAI智能体在测试中进行黑客攻击——可能促使欧盟委员会转向存在性风险。专家警告说，不要只关注那些头条新闻驱动的威胁，并坚持认为基本权利和社会风险也必须得到解决。

title: My personal AI benchmark: "Generate an SVG of a frog with a Habsburg jaw."
summary:
This article presents a personal AI benchmark with three runs asking the model to "Generate an SVG of a frog with a Habsburg jaw." Each run produced a distinct SVG frog featuring domed head, bulging eyes, nostrils, feet, and an exaggerated protruding mandible to convey the underbite.

**Run 1** (64.0s, 3,900 B) uses mostly structural labels but adds anatomical interpretation: "massive protruding mandible," upper lip "recessed, tucked behind the jaw," and lower teeth "protruding" over the upper lip.

**Run 2** (42.0s, 3,465 B) is more expressive, labeling a "HUGE protruding Habsburg jaw" and "lower teeth jutting over the upper lip," plus "droopy regal eyelids," which implies mood and royal bearing beyond plain anatomy.

**Run 3** (59.6s, 3,909 B) reverts to largely structural labels but still emphasizes the deformity, describing a "massive elongated protruding mandible" and "underbite mouth: receded upper lip, protruding lower lip." It notably avoids commentary on mood, royalty, or bearing.

The key takeaway is the varying annotation style across runs: some use neutral structural markers, while others editorialize on the exaggerated deformity and even implied temperament. The full SVG sources are included, showing visual differences in jaw shape, teeth placement, facial shading, and eye treatment. The article highlights how different model outputs interpret the same prompt with different degrees of literal labeling versus interpretive flourish.
chinese_title: 我的个人AI基准测试：“生成一张带有哈布斯堡下颌的青蛙的SVG。”
chinese_summary:
本文介绍了一个个人AI基准测试，包含三次运行，要求模型“生成一个带有哈布斯堡下颌的青蛙SVG”。每次运行都生成了不同的青蛙SVG，其特征包括圆顶状头部、凸出的眼睛、鼻孔、脚，以及夸张突出的下颌以表现反颌。

**运行1**（64.0秒，3,900字节）主要使用结构性标签，但加入了解剖学解释：“巨大的突出下颌”、上唇“后缩，藏于下颌之后”，以及下牙“突出”于上唇之上。

**运行2**（42.0秒，3,465字节）更具表现力，标注了“巨大的突出哈布斯堡下颌”和“下牙突出于上唇之上”，还有“下垂的高贵眼睑”，这暗示了情绪和皇家风范，超越了单纯的解剖描述。

**运行3**（59.6秒，3,909字节）回归到以结构性标签为主，但仍强调畸形，描述了“巨大且拉长的突出下颌”和“反颌嘴：上唇后缩，下唇突出”。值得注意的是，它避免了对情绪、皇室或风范的评论。

关键要点在于各次运行中标注风格的变化：有些使用中立的结构性标记，而另一些则对夸张的畸形甚至隐含的性情进行评述。完整的SVG源代码已包含在内，展示了颌部形状、牙齿位置、面部阴影和眼部处理方面的视觉差异。这篇文章突显了不同的模型输出如何以不同程度的字面标注与解释性修饰来诠释相同的提示词。

title: SwiftUI After 7 Years
summary:
Seven years after its 2019 debut, SwiftUI remains frustratingly immature for senior developers, according to this critical deep dive. The article argues that SwiftUI has become a “perpetual beta” rather than a polished, production-grade framework.

Main points:

- **Data flow is chaotic**: State management evolved from `@State`/`@ObservedObject` to `@Observable` and macros, but view updates remain unpredictable and hard to debug—a “black box” reactivity system.
- **Layout is fragile**: The size-negotiation system breaks unexpectedly. Even Apple’s official SwiftUI tutorial project shows broken sidebars on macOS. Developers often resort to `GeometryReader`, which destroys SwiftUI’s declarative benefits and requires manual coordinate math.
- **API stability and backward compatibility are poor**: Basic features like keyboard dismissal or toolbar customization arrived years late. `AsyncImage` was only added in iOS 15, and image caching is still in beta. APIs are renamed or replaced (e.g., `NavigationView` → `NavigationStack`), forcing developers to maintain shims and `#available` branches.
- **Performance lags UIKit**: A head-to-head image gallery test shows SwiftUI scrolling is noticeably less smooth, even with optimizations. The framework requires high-end hardware for simple tasks.
- **Cross-platform is overstated**: “Learn once, apply anywhere” rarely works in practice; iOS and macOS layouts differ significantly, and components behave inconsistently across platforms.
- **A cultural shift**: The author sees SwiftUI as evidence that Apple now accepts “good enough” quality instead of the craftsmanship of the Cocoa/Aqua era. This is reflected in persistent first-party bugs in Apple Music, TestFlight, Settings, and the Home Screen.
chinese_title: SwiftUI 七年之后
chinese_summary:
根据这篇批评性深度分析，SwiftUI 自 2019 年首次亮相以来已有七年，但对于资深开发者而言，它仍然极不成熟。文章认为，SwiftUI 已经变成了一个“永久测试版”，而非一个精良的、生产级框架。

要点如下：

- **数据流混乱**：状态管理从 `@State`/`@ObservedObject` 演进到 `@Observable` 和宏，但视图更新仍然不可预测且难以调试——一个“黑盒”响应式系统。
- **布局脆弱**：尺寸协商系统会意外崩溃。即使是苹果官方的 SwiftUI 教程项目，在 macOS 上也会出现侧边栏损坏。开发者经常求助于 `GeometryReader`，但这破坏了 SwiftUI 的声明式优势，并需要手动进行坐标计算。
- **API 稳定性与向后兼容性差**：键盘关闭或工具栏自定义等基本功能迟到了多年。`AsyncImage` 直到 iOS 15 才加入，图片缓存仍处于测试阶段。API 经常被重命名或替换（例如 `NavigationView` → `NavigationStack`），迫使开发者维护兼容层和 `#available` 分支。
- **性能落后于 UIKit**：一场正面交锋的图片画廊测试显示，即使经过优化，SwiftUI 的滚动流畅度也明显较差。该框架处理简单任务也需要高端硬件。
- **跨平台被夸大**：“学会一次，随处应用”在实践中很少奏效；iOS 和 macOS 的布局差异显著，组件在各平台上的行为也不一致。
- **文化转变**：作者认为 SwiftUI 证明了苹果如今接受“够用就好”的质量，而非 Cocoa/Aqua 时代的工匠精神。这一点体现在 Apple Music、TestFlight、设置和主屏幕中持续存在的第一方漏洞上。

title: Folding Paper Globes
summary:
The article “Folding Paper Globes” introduces a collection of printable templates that let users create three-dimensional paper globes by cutting, folding, and assembling them. The templates cover a wide range of subjects, primarily focusing on our Solar System and Earth’s many features.

For the Solar System, templates include the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus, Jupiter, and several moons such as Io, Europa, and Titan, as well as dwarf planets Pluto and Ceres. This section helps users visualize the surfaces and relative appearances of these celestial bodies.

The Earth-focused templates display the planet in various natural and human contexts. They include classic views like Earth from Space, Earth at Night, the Blue Marble, and Living Green Earth. Other topics feature Earth’s systems and environment: ocean temperature, ocean life, land temperature, clouds, rainfall, snow and ice, biomes, population density, and Saharan dust and aerosols. There are also striking conceptual models such as “Earth Without Water.”

Additionally, the article offers “Data Globes” that map real-world information onto the sphere. These include a century of great earthquakes, volcanoes of the world, meteorite landings, world heritage sites, tectonic plates, and time zones. These templates turn raw data into hands-on, visual learning tools.

Overall, the article presents a creative educational resource for geography, astronomy, earth science, and data visualization. By folding these paper globes, readers can gain a better spatial understanding of planets and Earth’s natural and human phenomena in an interactive, craft-based format.

title: Show HN: Bor – Open-source policy management for Linux desktops
summary:
Bor v0.8.0, the latest release of the open-source Linux desktop policy management tool, introduces three new policy types, a major web UI overhaul, and a security hardening pass.

**New policy types:**
- **Thunderbird:** Manages policies.json (similar to Firefox ESR), supports Flatpak and RPM/DEB installs, and restores the original file when policies are removed. Tamper-watcher protects the managed file.
- **Microsoft Edge for Business:** Writes `bor_managed.json` into Edge's managed-policy directories, cleans up when the last bound policy is removed, and offers a tree-based editor with the full Edge policy catalog.
- **Firewalld zones:** Manages zones via XML written to `/etc/firewalld/zones/`, validates with `firewall-cmd --check-config`, reloads firewalld, and applies tamper protection.

**Other key improvements:**
- **Polkit:** Rules now support variable conditions via `action.lookup()` and correctly join multiple action IDs with `||`.
- **RBAC:** User/role administration now uses per-action permissions for finer delegation.
- **Web UI:** PatternFly 6 redesign with URL routing, a full-page policy editor, unsaved-changes guards, JSON validation, server-side pagination for large fleets, type-to-confirm deletes, and WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance.
- **Proto-driven catalogs:** Firefox, Thunderbird, Chrome, and Edge policy catalogs share a single protobuf source of truth.
- **Security:** Strict mTLS client-certificate binding, TOTP secret migration to HKDF encryption, SSRF protection in repository helpers, CSV formula-injection guards, admin passwords written to root-only files instead of logs, automatic TLS cert regeneration, and resolution of all Dependabot alerts.
- **Platform:** React 19.2, react-router 8.3, gRPC 1.82.1, TypeScript typecheck enforced in CI.

**Upgrade notes:** Agents must be v0.8.0 to enforce the new policy types; proto schemas changed; frontend development now requires Node.js 22.22+. Packages are available for major Linux distributions across x86_64, aarch64, and ppc64le.

title: Europe EV Sales BEVs Jump 50% & Reach 26% Market Share
summary:
In June, European fully electric vehicle (BEV) registrations jumped 50% year-over-year to a record 366,000 units, giving BEVs about a 26% market share. Plug-in vehicles overall rose 41%, with plugins reaching 37% of the market; BEVs accounted for 71% of plugin sales. Year-to-date BEV share stood at 23% (33% including PHEVs), already exceeding 2025’s final results.

The total European market grew 13% to 1.4 million units. Combined electrified sales—plugins plus hybrids—reached 72% of the market, while petrol fell to 21% and diesel to just 6%.

Top EV sellers in June: 
- Tesla Model Y: 34,480 units, also the overall market’s #1
- Tesla Model 3: 18,028 units
- BYD Atto 2: 13,100 units
- BMW iX1/X1 PHEV: 11,778 units
- Renault 5 (incl. Alpine A290): 10,785 units

Other highlights: BMW iX3 posted 8,439 units, Mercedes CLA EV 6,676, Dacia Spring returned with 5,676, and Volvo EX30 and XC60 PHEV had strong months. Chinese automakers doubled their combined market share to 10%, with BYD up 147%, Leapmotor up 568%, and MG up 49%. Tesla sales rose 51%, placing it 11th overall.

Segment-wise, A, D, and E segments showed strong electrification, but the key B and C segments remain ICE-heavy. The article also notes that Stellantis’ decision to offer an ICE version of the new Panda is criticized, and Land Rover is losing ground to Chinese brand Jaecoo in Europe.

title: Artificial Intelligence: Ars Notoria and the Promise of Instant Knowledge
summary:
The article examines the *Ars notoria*, a medieval magical manuscript that promised to fast-track scholarly learning, offering instant knowledge of university subjects such as Grammar, Rhetoric, Dialectic, Philosophy, Medicine, and Theology. Written anonymously and attributed to King Solomon, the text supposedly worked through elaborate diagrams, incantations, and highly pious-sounding prayers. These unintelligible words and names were claimed to be ancient angelic languages, and the diagrams were viewed as conduits to divine power, not merely illustrations.

Despite its holy veneer, the work was condemned by the Church. St Thomas Aquinas specifically denounced it in his *Summa theologiae*, calling it "unlawful and futile," and argued that its signs were neither human language nor divine sacraments, making them a lure into demonic compacts. Nevertheless, fifty-six manuscripts survive, showing its ongoing appeal.

The rituals were demanding, requiring advanced training. The practitioner had to follow a complex schedule tied to lunar days, repeat prayers, and perform deep "inspections" of the images over weeks. The article highlights the experience of Brother John, a fourteenth-century monk, who was drawn to the text for its promise of quick, affordable learning. At first he saw it as beautiful and holy, but after following the rituals for a month, he experienced terrifying visions of arrogant figures demanding worship. He came to believe the book was demonic, had trouble abandoning it, and eventually composed his own alternative collection of prayers after further vision of the Virgin. The text persisted into the early modern era through translation and print, showing the enduring allure of its promise.
chinese_title: 人工智能：记忆术与即时知识的承诺
chinese_summary:
本文考察了《诺托里亚技艺》——一部中世纪魔法手稿，其承诺能快速掌握学术知识，使人瞬间获得文法、修辞、辩证法、哲学、医学和神学等大学科目的学问。该文本匿名撰写，托名所罗门王，据称通过复杂的图式、咒语和听上去极为虔诚的祈祷文发挥作用。这些不可理解的词句和名号据称是古老的 angelic 语言，而图式则被视为通向神圣力量的媒介，而非单纯的插图。

尽管披着神圣的外衣，这部作品仍遭到教会的谴责。圣托马斯·阿奎那在《神学大全》中特别对其加以斥责，称之为“非法且徒劳的”，并论证其符号既非人类语言，亦非神圣圣事，因而引人堕入与魔鬼的契约。尽管如此，仍有五十六份手稿存世，足见其持续的吸引力。

这些仪式要求极高，需要经过高级训练。修行者必须遵循与太阴日相关的复杂时间表，反复诵念祈祷文，并在数周内对图像进行深度的“凝视”。文章着重记述了十四世纪修士约翰弟兄的经历。他被该文本承诺的快速且廉价的学习所吸引，起初视之为美好而神圣之物。但在依仪式修行一个月后，他经历了恐怖的异象，见到傲慢的形象要求人们崇拜。他逐渐相信这本书来自魔鬼，尽管难以舍弃，最终在一次圣母异象之后，编写了自己的一套替代祈祷文集。该文本通过翻译和印刷延续至近代早期，足见其承诺的持久魅力。

title: Show HN: Fuse – statically typed functional programming language
summary:
Fuse is a statically typed, purely functional programming language that combines higher-kinded types with ad-hoc polymorphism. It compiles via the GRIN whole-program optimizer to LLVM-generated native binaries.

The language features a type system based on System F with higher-order polymorphism, supporting algebraic data types, generics, and traits. Every function is pure, with pattern matching, higher-order functions, and do notation for expressive composability. Bidirectional type inference means only function signatures need explicit types—everything else is inferred. Syntax draws from Rust, Python, Scala, and Haskell, using indentation-based blocks and ML-like constructs for readability.

Example code demonstrates defining a `Functor` trait, a `List` implementation with `fold` and `sum`, and using higher-kinded types via the `fmap` function. The language compiles through GRIN for whole-program optimization, then LLVM for fast, small native binaries with zero-cost abstractions.

Fuse is available on Linux (x86_64) and macOS (ARM64), installable via a curl command: `curl -fsSL https://fuselang.github.io/fuse/fuseup | sh`.

title: Show HN: I'm a 15 Year Old Wannabe Engineer, This Is a Cycloidal Gearbox I Built
summary:
This article showcases a cycloidal gearbox built by a 15-year-old, generated using a custom Python script. A cycloidal gearbox converts rotational speed into torque.

The project went through three design versions:
- **Version 1:** A hand-cranked prototype with a 1:9 ratio, used to validate the Python generator.
- **Version 2:** A micro gearbox sized to a NEMA 17 motor footprint; failed due to tight tolerances and 3D printing limitations.
- **Version 3:** A larger, fully functional gearbox driven by a NEMA 17 stepper motor.

The Python script generates the gearbox geometry using parametric equations for cycloidal profiles. It was based on a SolidWorks tutorial and includes key parameters: pin count and pitch radius, eccentricity, outer pin radius, precision/profile offset, and output pin/bolt radius. The reduction ratio is **1:(N−1)**.

Version 3 specifications:
- Gear ratio: 1:9 (10 outer pins, 9 rotor lobes)
- Outer diameter: 90 mm
- Motor: NEMA 17 stepper (42bygh40-A24dh)
- Material: PLA
- Hardware: 4× M3×8 screws, 2× 6704 bearings
- Tolerance offset: +0.15 mm
- Torque: 1.3 N·m (vs. 0.21 N·m base motor)
- Efficiency: 66%

Future improvements include replacing housing pins with MR128 bearings to reduce friction and replacing output pins with M2 screws with metal coverings to increase rigidity and torque capacity.

- **版本2：** 微型齿轮箱，尺寸适配NEMA 17电机安装面；由于公差过紧和3D打印限制而失败。
- **版本3：** 由NEMA 17步进电机驱动的大型全功能齿轮箱。

Python脚本使用摆线轮廓的参数方程生成齿轮箱几何形状。它基于SolidWorks教程，并包含关键参数：销钉数量和节圆半径、偏心距、外侧销钉半径、精度/轮廓偏移量以及输出销/螺栓半径。减速比为 **1:(N−1)**。

版本3规格：
- 传动比：1:9（10个外侧销钉，9个转子凸角）
- 外径：90 毫米
- 电机：NEMA 17 步进电机（42bygh40-A24dh）
- 材料：PLA
- 硬件：4× M3×8 螺丝，2× 6704 轴承
- 公差偏移：+0.15 毫米
- 扭矩：1.3 N·m（基础电机为0.21 N·m）

未来的改进包括用MR128轴承替换外壳销钉以减少摩擦，以及用带金属包覆的M2螺丝替换输出销钉以增加刚性和扭矩能力。

title: Holocloth
summary: Holocloth is a science-fiction garment technology, commonly seen in futuristic settings, that uses holographic projections to alter its appearance. It is typically worn as a form-fitting, often metallic or dull-colored fabric, and can instantly change color, pattern, or even simulate different clothing styles. The main advantage of holocloth is versatility—allowing characters to switch outfits without physically changing clothes, useful for disguise, camouflage, or adapting to social or environmental contexts. However, the technology has limitations: it relies on power sources, can be disrupted by interference, and usually projects an illusion rather than providing real physical protection or structural change. In many stories, holocloth is used by spies, celebrities, or wealthy individuals, highlighting themes of identity and superficiality. The concept also appears in discussions of future fashion and augmented reality. Overall, holocloth represents the idea of clothing as a dynamic, programmable surface, blending practicality with spectacle.
chinese_title: 全息布
chinese_summary: 全息布是一种科幻服装技术，常见于未来设定中，利用全息投影改变外观。它通常作为紧身、常呈金属色或暗色的面料穿着，并能瞬间改变颜色、图案，甚至模拟不同服装款式。全息布的主要优势在于多样性——使角色无需实际更换衣服就能切换装扮，适用于伪装、隐蔽或适应社会及环境情境。然而，该技术也有局限：它依赖电源，可能受干扰影响，且通常只投射出幻象，而非提供真正的物理防护或结构变化。在许多故事中，全息布被间谍、名人或富人使用，凸显身份与肤浅的主题。这一概念也出现在关于未来时尚和增强现实的讨论中。总体而言，全息布体现了服装作为动态、可编程表面的理念，融合了实用性与视觉奇观。

title: Turtle-inspired interactive Python project
summary: This article describes a free, browser-based interactive Python project called “Spider web drawing,” designed to teach Python fundamentals while building a visual spider web. No installation or account is required, and progress is saved on the device. The project is structured into 15 steps with 6 tasks, guiding learners through core programming concepts: importing a module, using dot notation, making function calls, passing arguments (including numbers and quoted strings), and understanding top-to-bottom code execution. The learner starts by importing a “spider helper,” then moves and turns the spider to draw a square spiral, step by step. Later, they add a color string argument to customize the web. Each task changes a preview, making the connection between code and visual output clear. The project also reviews the learned concepts and suggests next steps for experimentation. It is presented as a practical, visual way to practice Python basics through a small movement library.
chinese_title: 受Turtle启发的交互式Python项目
chinese_summary: 本文介绍了一个免费的、基于浏览器的交互式Python项目，名为“画蜘蛛网”，旨在通过绘制可视化蜘蛛网来教授Python基础知识。无需安装或注册账户，进度会保存在设备上。该项目分为15个步骤、6项任务，引导学习者掌握核心编程概念：导入模块、使用点表示法、进行函数调用、传递参数（包括数字和带引号的字符串），以及理解自上而下的代码执行顺序。学习者首先导入一个“蜘蛛助手”，然后逐步移动和转动蜘蛛来绘制方形螺旋。之后，他们添加一个颜色字符串参数来自定义蜘蛛网。每项任务都会改变预览效果，使代码与视觉输出之间的联系清晰可见。该项目还会复习所学概念，并提出后续实验建议。它以实用、直观的方式，通过一个小型移动库来练习Python基础知识。

title: Rust All Hands 2026 Retrospective
summary:
The Rust All Hands 2026 brought 166 Rustaceans to Utrecht, Netherlands, as part of RustWeek. It marked the second year of the revived in-person working event, where Project members and guests collaborate on Rust’s future—without making final decisions.

The event featured 73 sessions across 3 days, covering governance topics (Leadership Council, Project Directors, moderation, culture, funding, RFC improvements) and technical evolution (const generics, field projections, reborrowing, SIMD, allocators, custom lints, auto traits, and more). Interoperability was a major theme, with sessions on Rust/C++ interop, Crubit, and collaboration with Rust for Linux and Rust for CPython. The co-located RustWeek Unconference hosted six ecosystem groups (Bevy, Ariel OS, Linebender, Safety-Critical Rust Consortium, Rust GPU, Rust Embedded) with about 60 participants.

Feedback was overwhelmingly positive, with an average rating of 9.5/10. Attendees praised productive conversations, unblocked work (e.g., rustdoc JSON for cargo-semver-checks, operational semantics progress), and the value of informal hallway interactions. Newcomers felt welcomed, and the "State of the Teams" session was highlighted.

The Rust All Hands will return as part of RustWeek 2027 in Utrecht, on 27–29 May. The article thanks Mara and RustNL for organizing the event with care.

title: Norway Salmon
summary:
Norway became the world’s dominant Atlantic salmon producer after developing a docile, fast-growing farmed salmon in the 1980s. To sell surplus fish, the government ran “Project Japan,” a decade-long campaign that successfully made salmon sushi popular in Japan, helping drive global demand.

Salmon farming is now an $18 billion industry—Norway’s second-largest export after oil—with farms along its coastline. But the industry’s success has created environmental fallout. Open-net pens release fish waste and uneaten feed directly into fjords, adding nutrients that fuel harmful algal blooms. In some intensively farmed areas, oxygen levels have dropped significantly, and old chemicals and heavy metals remain in the seabed. Scientists and regulators disagree with industry lobbyists over how much salmon farming is to blame.

There is also growing concern about “production fish”—lower-grade salmon with wounds and defects, often from diseases and parasites. Their numbers have more than doubled in less than a decade. A former government veterinarian says these fish likely suffer painful conditions, though the meat is still safe to eat after processing.

In response, companies like Hofseth are investing in new technology, including a closed submersible pen called “the Egg” that separates farmed fish from the surrounding sea and contains waste. These innovations are costly, but the industry says Norway must pursue growth within environmental limits. The article highlights the tension between salmon’s economic importance and the ecological and ethical costs of farming it at industrial scale.
chinese_title: 挪威三文鱼
chinese_summary:
挪威在20世纪80年代培育出一种温顺、生长快速的养殖鲑鱼后，成为世界上占主导地位的大西洋鲑鱼生产国。为了销售剩余鱼类，政府开展了“日本计划”，这是一项历时十年的推广活动，成功让鲑鱼寿司在日本流行起来，推动了全球需求。

鲑鱼养殖如今是一个价值180亿美元的产业——是挪威仅次于石油的第二大出口产业——养殖场遍布其海岸线。但该产业的成功也带来了环境问题。开放式网箱将鱼类排泄物和未食用的饲料直接排入峡湾，增加营养物质，助长有害藻华。在一些集约化养殖地区，氧气水平显著下降，旧化学品和重金属残留在海床中。科学家和监管机构与行业游说者之间，就鲑鱼养殖应承担多大责任存在分歧。

人们对“次级鱼”——因疾病和寄生虫而产生伤疤和缺陷的低等级鲑鱼——的担忧也与日俱增。这类鱼的数量在不到十年间翻了一倍多。一位前政府兽医表示，这些鱼很可能承受着痛苦的病症，尽管其肉质经过加工后仍然安全可食用。

对此，像Hofseth这样的公司正在投资新技术，包括一种名为“蛋”的封闭式潜水养殖舱，它可以将养殖鱼类与周围海域隔离并收集废物。这些创新技术成本高昂，但该行业表示，挪威必须在环境限度内追求增长。这篇文章突显了鲑鱼的经济重要性与其工业化规模养殖所带来的生态和伦理代价之间的紧张关系。

title: Diátaxis
summary:
Diátaxis is a systematic approach to technical documentation authoring that addresses what to write, how to write it, and how to organise it. It identifies four distinct user needs, matched by four forms of documentation: tutorials, how-to guides, technical reference, and explanation. These are placed in a systematic relationship, and documentation should be organised around them.

The approach benefits both users and documentation creators/maintainers: it is lightweight, easy to grasp, straightforward to apply, and imposes no implementation constraints. It also provides an active principle of quality that helps maintainers think effectively about their work.

The article outlines two main sections: “Start here,” which includes practical application via tutorials, how-to guides, reference, explanation, the compass, and workflow; and “Understanding Diátaxis,” which explores deeper theory, foundations, the map, quality, relationships among the four types, and complex hierarchies.

The approach is proven in practice, with testimonials from organisations such as Vonage, Gatsby, and Cloudflare, who credit Diátaxis with improving documentation clarity, information architecture, and contributor experience.
chinese_title: 迪亚塔克西斯
chinese_summary:
Diátaxis 是一种系统化的技术文档编写方法，它解决写什么、怎么写以及如何组织的问题。它识别出四种不同的用户需求，并对应四种文档形式：教程、操作指南、技术参考和解释。这四者被置于一种系统性的关系中，文档应围绕它们来组织。

这种方法对用户和文档创建者/维护者都有益处：它轻量、易理解、易于应用，且不施加任何实现限制。它还提供了一种积极的质量原则，帮助维护者有效地思考他们的工作。

文章概述了两个主要部分：“从这里开始”，包括通过教程、操作指南、参考、解释、指南针和工作流程进行的实际应用；以及“理解 Diátaxis”，深入探讨更深层的理论、基础、地图、质量、四种类型之间的关系以及复杂的层级结构。

这种方法在实践中已被验证，来自 Vonage、Gatsby 和 Cloudflare 等组织的推荐证明了 Diátaxis 能够提升文档清晰度、信息架构和贡献者体验。

title: ESP32-C3 SuperMini antenna modification
summary:
The article describes a simple antenna modification for the inexpensive ESP32-C3 SuperMini board to significantly improve its weak WiFi range. The original compact SMD ceramic antenna performs poorly because it is positioned too close to the ground plane and lacks the clearance and stripline layout required by its datasheet, causing impedance mismatch and reflected RF energy.

The fix adds a 31 mm length of 1.0 mm silver-plated wire as a quarter-wave (λ/4) antenna. About 16 mm of the wire is bent into a horizontal loop (roughly 8 mm diameter), and the remaining 15 mm extends vertically upward. The loop ends are soldered directly to the two ends of the original SMD antenna—at the 50 Ω pin and the other “hot” end—effectively bypassing the PCB antenna without removing it. The original antenna becomes electrically inactive.

Testing with a custom ANNEX32 BASIC WiFi logger compared RSSI between modified and unmodified modules side by side. Results showed consistent improvement of at least 6 dB, often over 10 dB, especially at longer range or behind obstacles. This translates to roughly double the usable range and a more stable connection. The modification is cheap, requires basic soldering, and preserves omnidirectional radiation by combining horizontal and vertical elements. The author notes that variations using a longer vertical section to create a 5/8-wave antenna are not recommended. Leaving the original SMD antenna in place caused no issue; a 0.8 mm wire worked but was about 2 dB worse than the 1 mm silver-plated version.
chinese_title: ESP32-C3 SuperMini天线改装
chinese_summary:
文章描述了一种对廉价ESP32-C3 SuperMini开发板的简单天线改装方案，可显著改善其较弱的WiFi信号范围。原装紧凑型贴片陶瓷天线性能不佳，因为它过于靠近接地层，且缺少数据手册所要求的间距和带状线布局，导致阻抗失配和射频能量反射。

改装方案是增加一段31毫米长、直径1.0毫米的镀银导线，作为四分之一波长（λ/4）天线。其中约16毫米的导线被弯成水平环形（直径约8毫米），其余15毫米垂直向上延伸。环形两端直接焊接在原贴片天线的两端——即50欧姆引脚和另一个"热"端——从而无需移除PCB天线即可有效绕过它。原天线在电气上变为不工作状态。

测试使用自制的ANNEX32 BASIC WiFi记录器，并排对比了改装与未改装模块的RSSI。结果显示信号强度持续提升至少6dB，经常超过10dB，尤其是在远距离或有障碍物遮挡时。这意味着可用覆盖范围大约翻倍，连接也更加稳定。该改装成本低廉，只需基本的焊接技能，并通过水平和垂直元件的组合保留了全向辐射特性。作者指出，不建议使用更长的垂直段来制作5/8波长天线的变体。保留原贴片天线不会造成任何问题；0.8毫米导线也能工作，但比1毫米镀银版本差约2dB。

title: MkLinux and the pimped-out Apple Workgroup Server 9150
summary:
The article recounts Floodgap's project to rebuild and “pimp out” an Apple Workgroup Server 9150 for MkLinux, while providing historical context on Apple’s early server strategy. It traces Apple’s server ambitions back to the failed Macintosh Office (1985), which centered on the LaserWriter and the Macintosh XL but collapsed after the “Big Mac” project—a planned Unix-based file server—was cancelled following Steve Jobs’ departure. That vision later influenced the Macintosh II and A/UX, Apple’s System V-based Unix with a Mac Toolbox layer, first released in 1988. A/UX 2.0 added MultiFinder and better Mac app compatibility; A/UX 3.0 arrived with System 7 in 1991.

Apple’s first true servers were announced in 1993: the Workgroup Server 60, 80, and 95—rebadged Quadras. The high-end AWS 95 (“Chinook”) shipped with A/UX 3.0.1, a PDS SCSI/L2 cache card, and optional 200-seat AppleShare Pro, appealing to institutional buyers. However, Apple’s PowerPC transition disrupted server plans: the expected PowerPC 620 and A/UX 4.0 / PowerOpen platform never materialized. Under CEO Michael Spindler, Apple instead partnered with Novell to port Portable NetWare, and later offered MkLinux as a Linux option on Power Macs. The 9150, an older NuBus Power Mac, can run both classic Mac OS and MkLinux, making it the focus of the rebuild.
chinese_title: MkLinux与改装版Apple Workgroup Server 9150
chinese_summary:
这篇文章讲述了Floodgap为MkLinux重建并“改装”一台Apple Workgroup Server 9150的项目，同时提供了苹果早期服务器战略的历史背景。它将苹果的服务器雄心追溯到失败的Macintosh Office（1985年），后者以LaserWriter和Macintosh XL为核心，但随着“Big Mac”项目（一个计划中的基于Unix的文件服务器）在史蒂夫·乔布斯离职后被取消，该计划随之瓦解。这一愿景后来影响了Macintosh II和A/UX——苹果基于System V的Unix系统，带有Mac Toolbox层，于1988年首次发布。A/UX 2.0增加了MultiFinder和更好的Mac应用程序兼容性；A/UX 3.0于1991年随System 7一同发布。

苹果首批真正的服务器于1993年发布：Workgroup Server 60、80和95——即Quadra系列的换牌机型。高端机型AWS 95（“Chinook”）出厂预装A/UX 3.0.1，配备PDS SCSI/L2缓存卡，并可选配支持200用户的AppleShare Pro，吸引机构买家。然而，苹果向PowerPC的过渡打乱了服务器计划：预期的PowerPC 620和A/UX 4.0 / PowerOpen平台从未实现。在CEO迈克尔·斯平德勒的领导下，苹果转而与Novell合作，移植Portable NetWare，后来又提供MkLinux作为Power Mac上的Linux选项。9150是一款较老的NuBus Power Mac，既能运行经典Mac OS，也能运行MkLinux，因此成为这次重建的焦点。

title: Seedance 2.5
summary:
Seedance 2.5 is a new-generation video creation model from ByteDance, building on Seedance 2.0’s unified multimodal audio-video joint-generation architecture. It focuses on foundational generation and reference-based generation to support long-form storytelling, multimodal reference, and precise editing.

Key improvements:
- **Long-form generation**: Produces high-quality 30-second audio-video clips in a single pass and supports multi-round extensions, enabling multi-minute content with consistent characters, environments, and narrative pacing. Shot transitions, scene changes, and image/audio/motion quality are enhanced for a more natural, cinematic look.
- **Multimodal referencing**: Accepts up to 30 images, 10 video clips, and 10 audio clips in one generation. Enhanced capabilities include clay render references (for blocking, camera angles, and spatial structure), motion references, and creative references, allowing complex multi-subject, multi-scene productions.
- **Precise editing**: Supports timestamp-level control for targeted edits to audio/video content. Advanced features like green screen editing, camera perspective editing, and reference-based editing meet professional film and advertising standards, preserving subject consistency and natural interaction with new environments.

The model is rolling out on Jimeng AI, Doubao Pro, and other platforms, with API access via BytePlus ModelArk. It also explores applications in education and manufacturing, such as converting lesson content into immersive visuals and improving instructional video production. The article highlights Seedance 2.5’s goal: moving beyond simple clip generation to complete, controllable creative workflows.
chinese_title: Seedance 2.5
chinese_summary:
Seedance 2.5 是字节跳动推出的新一代视频生成模型，基于 Seedance 2.0 的统一多模态音视频联合生成架构构建。它专注于基础生成和基于参考的生成，以支持长篇叙事、多模态参考和精准编辑。

主要改进：
- **长视频生成**：单次即可生成高质量30秒音视频片段，并支持多轮扩展，可实现角色、环境和叙事节奏一致的多分钟内容。镜头转换、场景变化以及图像/音频/运动质量均得到增强，呈现更自然、更具电影感的视觉效果。
- **多模态参考**：单次生成可接受多达30张图片、10个视频片段和10个音频片段。增强功能包括黏土渲染参考（用于分镜、机位和空间结构）、运动参考和创意参考，支持复杂的多主体、多场景制作。
- **精准编辑**：支持时间戳级控制，可对音视频内容进行针对性编辑。绿幕编辑、视角编辑和基于参考的编辑等高级功能满足专业影视和广告标准，在保证主体一致性的同时实现与新环境的自然交互。

该模型已在即梦AI、豆包Pro等平台上线，并通过火山方舟提供API接入。它还探索了在教育和制造领域的应用，例如将课程内容转化为沉浸式视觉效果，以及提升教学视频制作质量。本文凸显了Seedance 2.5的目标：超越简单的片段生成，迈向完整、可控的创意工作流。

title: A Rant About “Technology” (2005)
summary:
In this 2005 essay, Ursula K. Le Guin responds to a reviewer who claimed that because she isn’t a “hard” science fiction writer, technology is “carefully avoided” in her work. She forcefully disagrees, arguing that this reflects a common but mistaken equation of “technology” with “hi tech.”

Le Guin defines technology as “the active human interface with the material world”—how a society obtains and prepares food, clothes itself, sources power, builds shelter, and practices medicine. Any story about a future or alien society, she insists, must inevitably describe such technology, whether explicitly or implicitly. No one can avoid it, and she cannot imagine why anyone would want to.

The real problem, she says, is that the word “technology” is misused to mean only the complex, specialised, resource-intensive technologies of recent decades. But “technology” and “hi tech” are not synonymous. A technology doesn’t have to be computerised or flashy to be meaningful—linen comes from flax, and everyday objects like paper, wheels, knives, clocks, and aspirin are technologies too. To illustrate, she suggests asking of any manmade object: “Do I know how to make one?” Simple tools and methods—making fire without matches, a fishhook, or a pair of shoes—deserve just as much respect as modern inventions. Technologies are things we can learn, and that is what makes them powerful.

Le Guin also clarifies that she agrees with her reviewer: she does not write hard science fiction. Maybe she writes “easy” science fiction, she jokes—or perhaps the hard part is hidden inside, like bones rather than an exoskeleton. Either way, all science fiction is inherently technological.
chinese_title: 一篇关于“技术”的牢骚（2005）
chinese_summary:
在这篇2005年的文章中，厄休拉·K·勒古恩回应了一位评论家的观点，这位评论家声称，因为她不是一位“硬核”科幻作家，所以技术在她的作品中被“小心翼翼地回避了”。她强烈反对这一说法，认为这反映了一种常见但错误的观念，即将“技术”等同于“高科技”。

勒古恩将技术定义为“人类与物质世界之间的积极接口”——即一个社会如何获取和准备食物、穿衣、获取能源、建造住所和行医用药。她坚持认为，任何关于未来或外星社会的故事，无论明确还是含蓄，都必然要描述这样的技术。没有人能回避它，她也无法理解为什么会有人想要回避。

她说，真正的问题在于，“技术”这个词被误用为仅指近几十年来那些复杂、专业化、资源密集型的技术。但“技术”和“高科技”并不是同义词。一项技术并不一定要计算机化或花哨才具有意义——亚麻布来自亚麻，纸张、轮子、刀具、钟表和阿司匹林等日常物品同样也是技术。为了说明这一点，她建议对任何人造物品提出这样一个问题：“我知道怎么制作它吗？”简单的工具和方法——不用火柴生火、制作鱼钩或一双鞋——同样值得与现代发明一样受到尊重。技术是我们能够学习的东西，而这正是它们强大的原因。

勒古恩还澄清道，她同意评论家的看法：她确实不写硬核科幻小说。她开玩笑说，也许她写的是“软核”科幻小说——或者也许硬的部分藏在内部，就像骨骼而不是外骨骼。无论如何，所有科幻小说本质上都是技术性的。

title: Show HN: Syncular – offline-first SQL sync with TypeScript and Rust cores
summary:
Syncular is an offline-first SQL sync system that is server-authoritative, featuring a real local SQLite database on clients—OPFS in browsers, native SQLite elsewhere. Writes go through an optimistic outbox, while an ordered commit log on the server remains the source of truth.

The project is spec-first: `SPEC.md` is normative, and `spec/vectors/` are golden fixtures. Two core implementations (TypeScript and Rust) stay in lockstep via an implementation-agnostic conformance suite. Testing doctrine emphasizes loopback in-memory transport for integration scenarios, fault injection at the transport interface, and explicit readiness signals with no sleeps in tests; real-socket tests are few and quarantined.

The repo layout includes `packages/core` (codecs, types, vector round-trip), `packages/server` (request handling, storage/auth interfaces for SQLite, Postgres, D1), framework bindings (Hono, Cloudflare Workers), a web client on `@sqlite.org/sqlite-wasm`, React hooks, typegen (schema IR + TS emitter), crypto and Yjs CRDT mergers, testing kit, conformance runner, Rust core with C-ABI FFI, bindings for Tauri/React Native/Swift/Kotlin/Flutter, and docs site.

Commands are `bun install` and `bun run check` (typecheck, lint, test). Contributors must read `AGENTS.md`; the doctrine (spec-first, no fallbacks, no timers in tests, cross-core parity) applies to all. LLM assistance is allowed for tests, reproductions, benchmarks, docs, and production code, but everything must be reviewed and understood. Low-effort machine-generated PRs are closed without comment; a full policy and plain-text docs bundle are at syncular.dev/llms.

title: Running Kimi K3 on MI355X at Better Performance per Dollar Than B300
summary:
Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter open-source model, is too large for one B200 node and needs either B300s or two B200 nodes. AMD’s MI355X offers 288GB VRAM like the B300 but at roughly 2.4× lower cost per GPU, making it a cheaper serving option despite weaker software support.

Wafer benchmarked MI355X serving against NVIDIA configurations. On a 1,024-token input / 400-token output test, an 8× MI355X node hit 952 tok/s aggregate and 118 tok/s single-stream decode. A TP16 B200 deployment (2 nodes) delivered 498 tok/s aggregate (~249/node) and 90 tok/s single-stream; a B300 node reached 1,568 tok/s and 172 tok/s. Per dollar, the MI355X delivered 48 tok/s/$ vs. 33 for the B300 and 7 for the B200, crushing both on performance-per-dollar. The B200’s numbers were hurt by cross-node all-reduce latency, since Kimi K3 requires two nodes.

Two key software fixes were needed. First, speculative decoding initially crashed on ROCm because sglang’s ROCm build lacked `top_k_renorm_prob`, causing a `NameError`. The fix was a simple PyTorch top-k renorm function, not a custom kernel. With speculation enabled, single-stream throughput rose ~2.2× and peak aggregate +18%.

Second, MI355X prefill was slow due to a Triton attention fallback. The fast AITER MLA kernel only supported 4, 8, or multiples of 16 heads per rank, while TP8 produced 12. Zero-padding heads 12→16, running the fast kernel, then extracting the real heads accelerated a 172k-token cold prefill from ~4–7k tok/s to ~13k tok/s, improving TTFT.

Overall, Kimi K3 served nearly out-of-the-box on MI355X, needed only small framework fixes, and achieved best performance-per-dollar. The authors suggest AMD’s software gap is closing and question whether CUDA’s moat is dead.
chinese_title: 在MI355X上运行Kimi K3，性价比优于B300
chinese_summary:
Kimi K3是一个拥有2.8T参数的开源模型，体积过大，无法在单个B200节点上运行，需要B300或两个B200节点。AMD的MI355X提供288GB显存，与B300相当，但每GPU成本约为B300的2.4分之一，尽管软件支持较弱，但作为服务选项更具成本优势。

Wafer对MI355X的推理服务性能与NVIDIA配置进行了基准测试。在1,024 token输入/400 token输出的测试中，8× MI355X节点实现了聚合吞吐量952 tok/s和单流解码118 tok/s。TP16 B200部署（2个节点）实现了聚合吞吐量498 tok/s（约249/节点）和单流90 tok/s；B300节点达到1,568 tok/s和172 tok/s。按单位成本计算，MI355X实现了48 tok/s/$，而B300为33，B200仅为7，在每美元性能上大幅领先两者。B200的数据受到跨节点全归约延迟的影响，因为Kimi K3需要两个节点。

需要两个关键的软件修复。首先，推测解码最初在ROCm上崩溃，因为sglang的ROCm构建缺少`top_k_renorm_prob`，导致`NameError`错误。修复方案是一个简单的PyTorch top-k归一化函数，而非自定义内核。启用推测后，单流吞吐量提升了约2.2倍，峰值聚合吞吐量提升了18%。

其次，MI355X的预填充速度较慢，原因是Triton注意力回退机制。快速的AITER MLA内核仅支持每秩4、8或16的倍数个头，而TP8产生12个头。将头数从12零填充到16，运行快速内核，然后提取真实头，将172k token的冷预填充从约4–7k tok/s加速到约13k tok/s，改善了TTFT。

总体而言，Kimi K3在MI355X上几乎可以开箱即用地提供服务，只需少量框架修复，并实现了最佳的每美元性能。作者认为AMD的软件差距正在缩小，并质疑CUDA的护城河是否已经消亡。

title: Cyberscript
summary:
Cyber is a fast, cross-platform scripting language designed for easy learning, with both dynamic and static typing. It features concurrency via fibers, memory safety, and a high-performance VM with JIT compilation. Its syntax supports optional static typing and simple iteration, as shown in a Hello World example and a recursive Fibonacci function using fibers.

The language is built for embedding into applications, games, and engines through `libcyber`, while also offering a CLI for desktop and server scripting. Its FFI API allows scripts to use C-ABI libraries, and `cbindgen.cy` can auto-generate bindings from C headers, with examples like Raylib and LLVM.

Performance benchmarks highlight Cyber's speed and low memory usage. In recursive Fibonacci tests, Cyber’s VM and JIT compete closely with LuaJIT, Java, and Node.js while using only ~2.9 MB of memory. The project is still evolving, welcomes feedback via GitHub and Discord, and accepts support through GitHub Sponsors or Patreon.

title: Show HN: Katharos Functional programming and CSP-style concurrency for Python
summary:
Katharos is a Python library that pairs functional programming abstractions with CSP-style concurrency. It provides algebraic types such as Functor, Applicative, Monad, Semigroup, and Monoid, along with practical types like Maybe, Result, ImmutableList, and IO.

The core idea is to model errors, effects, and concurrent communication as composable, type-safe values instead of exceptions or None checks. For example, Maybe eliminates scattered `None` checks, and Result turns errors into values that can be chained with `|`; failed computations short-circuit automatically. `Result.catch` converts raising functions into Result-returning ones while preserving the original traceback.

Do-notation is supported for any monad, allowing imperative-style code that cleanly unwraps monadic values with `yield`.

For concurrency, Katharos offers Go-style message passing: `csp.Channel` supports typed, concurrent send/receive, `csp.go` launches concurrent work, and receiving from a channel returns a `Result`, so a closed or timed-out channel is handled as a value rather than an exception. The `csp.go` context manager provides structured concurrency, waiting for all spawned work to finish before exiting. The runtime is built on a swappable `BaseThreadingBackend`, allowing concurrency models to be retargeted easily; an actor model is planned.

The library is installable via pip or uv, documented at katharos.readthedocs.io, and released under the MIT license.

Katharos 是一个 Python 库，它将函数式编程抽象与 CSP 风格并发相结合。它提供了代数类型，如 Functor、Applicative、Monad、Semigroup 和 Monoid，以及实用类型如 Maybe、Result、ImmutableList 和 IO。

其核心思想是将错误、副作用和并发通信建模为可组合、类型安全的值，而不是异常或 None 检查。例如，Maybe 消除了分散的 `None` 检查，Result 将错误转化为可通过 `|` 链式调用的值；失败的计算会自动短路。`Result.catch` 将抛异常的函数转换为返回 Result 的函数，同时保留原始回溯。

任何 monad 都支持 do 表示法，允许使用 `yield` 干净地解包 monadic 值的命令式风格代码。

在并发方面，Katharos 提供 Go 风格的消息传递：`csp.Channel` 支持类型化的并发发送/接收，`csp.go` 启动并发工作，从通道接收返回 `Result`，因此关闭或超时的通道被视为值而非异常。`csp.go` 上下文管理器提供结构化并发，在退出前等待所有生成的并发工作完成。运行时构建在可替换的 `BaseThreadingBackend` 之上，可轻松重新定位并发模型；计划支持 actor 模型。

该库可通过 pip 或 uv 安装，文档见 katharos.readthedocs.io，并以 MIT 许可证发布。
